player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Player {player_id} katika **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tuma mchezo wako kama **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni mini-bodi gani inayotumika
• *micro* = ni mraba gani ndani ya mini-bodi hiyo
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yako katika mini-bodi 7, mraba 8, na
lazima mpinzani wako atumie mini-bodi 8 inayofuata.

Inwe ni `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kethruokno nyaka bed e yo mar [macro micro] ka iketo namba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nyuktago duto nyaka bed e kind 0 kod 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row, kata col ok nyal chopo.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Jaduong' gikwinya atie kwenyu bodi ndogo inayofuata.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Oselochi e piem mar micro board.

game_action.played: Mchezaji {player_id} alitumia mini-bodi {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (safu {row}, safu wima {col}). Mchezaji {opponent_id} lazima sasa atumie {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Jalo {player_id} oloyo Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
